fiv_laws: F24 Layer Multiplicity; F3 Holonomy-Memory Repair

fiv_laws: F24 Layer Multiplicity; F6 No-Needles Stability; F9 No Unstatused Residual

fiv_laws: F24 Layer Multiplicity; F52 Closure Completeness Boundary

fiv_laws: F24 Layer Multiplicity; F9 No Unstatused Residual; F52 Closure Completeness Boundary
